answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because mirror only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, umber is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any crystal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
